name: land-record-system
description: Intelligent Land Record Digitization and Validation System (SIH-2026) — MERN + Python AI microservice

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,client,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service"
